observations.behavior: Adds a new ThousandEyes warehouse ingestion source, including REST API configuration, account parameter extraction, credential validation, and a resumable data import workflow.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a warehouse connector for ThousandEyes, allowing PostHog users to ingest HTTP server test results and alert state into warehouse tables. The connector supports bearer token authentication, account group ID, pagination, and checkpoint-based resumption. It also includes credential validation and a fallback to re-read recent rounds if agent reports are late.
